description: This file defines the React frontend page component `ShopsPage` used to list and interact with shops in a multi-shop billing system. It includes client-side data fetching, state management, UI rendering with tables and buttons, and local handling for loading, error, and empty states.

methods.name: ShopsPage
methods.description: Main React component that renders the shops list and handles interactions such as fetching data, setting active shop, and copying shop IDs.
